title: Give truthful tracking Resume guidance for disable-held closing custody
outcome: A disabled session with retained closing observation custody gets truthful supported recovery guidance instead of an ineffective unconditional retry instruction, while original immutable custody and authority fences remain intact.
acceptance: Existing removal/binding owners distinguish a disabled-held closing capture from a transient recoverable rebind and present the actual condition and supported next action.
Relevant controls preserve custody, queue pause and grant separation during the disabled state; no report is discarded or new authority invented to make Delete succeed.
